 GOAL - Atletico Madrid 1-0 Barcelona published at 20:11 GMT 20:11 GMT 
 Giuliano Simeone (10 mins) 
 The hosts take the lead and it's the manager's son who puts them in front. Atletico break down the right, switch it to the left, and then Julian Alverez drills a low cross across the face of the goal which Giuliano Simeone taps in at the back post.
